dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: The expectation of a real-valued function X under μ, defined as its Bochner integral ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the left-hand side the integral under μ of the indicator function.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real-valued indicator of a set E, equal to 1 on E and 0 outside E.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied to the strict superlevel set, it produces the random variable whose expectation is being computed.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Equality between two real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It asserts that the indicator's integral equals the real-valued measure of its support.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The generic strict-less-than operation supplied by an order instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the condition t < X ω defining the superlevel set.

dependency_coverage.name: Measurable
dependency_coverage.meaning: A function is measurable when preimages of measurable sets are measurable.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures that the strict superlevel set of X at every real threshold t is measurable.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasurableSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: A structure specifying the measurable subsets of Ω.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the domain measurable structure needed for μ and for measurability of X.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure
dependency_coverage.meaning: A typeclass proposition stating that μ is a probability measure, in particular μ univ = 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It guarantees finiteness of μ and hence integrability of the bounded indicator.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.Measure
dependency_coverage.meaning: A measure on the measurable space Ω.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the measure used both in the integral and in the measure of the superlevel event.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.Measure.real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real-valued measure μ.real s, defined as (μ s).toReal.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the right-hand side and converts the extended nonnegative measure of the event to a real number.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the codomain of X, the type of t, and the common type of both sides of the equality.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard strict order instance on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the event condition as ordinary real inequality t < X ω.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.measurableSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard Borel measurable space on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines what it means for the real-valued function X to be measurable.

dependency_coverage.name: setOf
dependency_coverage.meaning: The construction turning a predicate on Ω into the set of points satisfying it.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the event {ω | t < X ω}.

dependency_coverage.name: InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: A structure projection yielding the normed-space structure required for real-valued Bochner integration.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the typeclass infrastructure used to form the real Bochner integral.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.integral
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Bochner integral of a function with respect to a measure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the operation defining the expectation on the left-hand side.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: A structure projection supplying the seminormed additive commutative group structure needed by integration.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides part of the analytic typeclass infrastructure for integrating real-valued functions.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The generic interpretation of a natural-number numeral in a type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the numeral 1 used by the indicator as a real number.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: The mechanism deriving the interpretation of the numeral 1 from a One instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects the constant value one in the indicator to the real multiplicative identity.

dependency_coverage.name: RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard real inner-product-space structure associated with an RCLike type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For Real, it contributes the inner-product and normed-space structure used by Bochner integration.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard One instance on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the real value 1 taken by the indicator on the event.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instRCLike
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard RCLike analytic scalar structure on Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the inherited real analytic structures needed for the integral.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard Zero instance on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the real value 0 taken by the indicator outside the event.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.normedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard normed additive commutative group structure on Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the norm and additive structure required for real-valued Bochner integration.

dependency_coverage.name: Set
dependency_coverage.meaning: A set of elements of α, represented as a predicate α → Prop.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the type of the strict superlevel event passed to the indicator and the measure.

dependency_coverage.name: Set.indicator
dependency_coverage.meaning: The function equal to f x when x belongs to s and equal to 0 otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With f constantly 1, it is exactly the real-valued characteristic function of the superlevel event.

conclusions: The Bochner integral under μ of the real-valued indicator of {ω ∈ Ω | t < X ω} equals (μ {ω ∈ Ω | t < X ω}).toReal.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every measurable real-valued random variable X on the probability space (Ω, μ) and every real threshold t, the expectation of the indicator that X is strictly greater than t is exactly the probability of that strict superlevel event, represented as a real number.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The event uses the strict inequality t < X(ω), not t ≤ X(ω).
The conclusion concerns the real-valued Bochner integral of a real indicator, not an extended-nonnegative-valued integral.
Measurability of X ensures the superlevel event is measurable.
The probability-measure assumption ensures the indicator is integrable and its event has finite measure.
There is no apparent vacuity: the hypotheses describe ordinary measurable real-valued functions on probability spaces, and such objects exist.
ambiguities: The notation called expectation is definitionally the Bochner integral and does not introduce a separate expectation operator.
The right-hand side is explicitly the real conversion of an extended nonnegative measure value.
Several analytic structure dependencies are elaboration infrastructure and do not add independent mathematical assumptions.
